# Simon Fraser University
> Simon Fraser University is a Canadian public research university offering undergraduate, graduate, continuing education, research, and community programs across three campuses.

SFU serves prospective and current students, researchers, alumni, partners, and the public through academic programs, admissions resources, learning opportunities, research initiatives, campus services, and institutional information for Burnaby, Surrey, and Vancouver.

## Admissions
- [Admissions](https://www.sfu.ca/main/admission.html): Central admissions hub for undergraduate, graduate, and lifelong learner pathways.
- [Undergraduate Admission](https://www.sfu.ca/main/admission/undergraduate.html): Undergraduate application, requirements, deadlines, and next steps for future students.
- [Graduate Admission](https://www.sfu.ca/main/admission/graduate.html): Graduate admissions overview with program entry requirements and application guidance.
- [Lifelong Learner Admission](https://www.sfu.ca/main/admission/lifelong-learner.html): Admission information for non-degree, visiting, and lifelong learners.
- [SFU Admissions](https://www.sfu.ca/admission): University admissions portal with broader recruitment and applicant information.

## Programs and Academic Areas
- [Programs](https://www.sfu.ca/main/programs.html): Overview of academic programs, study options, and disciplinary areas.
- [What Can I Study?](https://www.sfu.ca/main/programs/what-can-i-study.html): Explore available fields of study, credentials, and academic options.
- [Faculties + Departments](https://www.sfu.ca/main/programs/faculties-departments.html): Directory of faculties, schools, and academic departments across SFU.
- [Athletics + Recreation](https://www.sfu.ca/main/programs/athletics-recreation.html): Athletics, recreation, and related student participation opportunities.
- [For Indigenous Peoples](https://www.sfu.ca/main/programs/for-indigenous-peoples.html): Academic pathways and support resources for Indigenous learners.
- [For International Students](https://www.sfu.ca/main/programs/for-international-students.html): Study options and academic information for international students.
- [Options in French](https://www.sfu.ca/main/programs/french.html): French-language study opportunities and related academic offerings.

## Learning and Student Development
- [Learning](https://www.sfu.ca/main/learning.html): Hub for learning opportunities, support services, and experiential education.
- [Teaching & Learning](https://www.sfu.ca/main/learning/advancing-teaching-learning.html): Resources focused on teaching excellence and learning advancement.
- [Degree Completion](https://www.sfu.ca/main/learning/degree-completion.html): Support and pathways for completing academic credentials.
- [Learning Support](https://www.sfu.ca/main/learning/learning-support.html): Academic support services and student learning assistance resources.
- [Work + Learn](https://www.sfu.ca/main/learning/work-learn.html): Work-integrated learning and employment-connected educational opportunities.
- [Community Learning](https://www.sfu.ca/main/learning/community-learning.html): Learning programs connected to communities and public engagement.
- [Study Abroad](https://www.sfu.ca/main/learning/study-abroad.html): International study opportunities and global learning experiences.
- [Leadership + Development](https://www.sfu.ca/main/learning/leadership-development.html): Leadership training and personal development opportunities for students.
- [Continuing Education](https://www.sfu.ca/main/learning/continuing-education.html): Continuing studies and professional learning opportunities.

## Research and Innovation
- [Research](https://www.sfu.ca/main/research.html): Research overview, priorities, partnerships, and institutional research activity.
- [About SFU](https://www.sfu.ca/main/about.html): Institutional overview including mission, leadership, and university profile.
- [Community](https://www.sfu.ca/main/sfu-community.html): Community-facing initiatives, engagement, and connections across SFU.

- [Emergency Information](https://www.sfu.ca/emergency): Emergency alerts, preparedness, and incident information for the university community.

## Main Entry Points
- [SFU Homepage](https://www.sfu.ca): Main university homepage with admissions, news, events, and campus highlights.
- [Admission](https://www.sfu.ca/main/admission.html): Primary entry point for prospective students exploring how to apply.
- [Programs](https://www.sfu.ca/main/programs.html): Starting point for exploring degrees, faculties, and study options.
- [Learning](https://www.sfu.ca/main/learning.html): Entry point for student support, experiential learning, and continuing education.
- [Research](https://www.sfu.ca/main/research.html): Starting point for research activity, impact, and partnerships.
- [About](https://www.sfu.ca/main/about.html): Entry point for institutional information, profile, and university context.
- [Community](https://www.sfu.ca/main/sfu-community.html): Entry point for community engagement and public-facing initiatives.
